heider-simmel.near: geometric shapes moving across a screen
heider-simmel.caption: A frame from Fritz Heider and Marianne Simmel’s 1944 film. Asked what they saw, nearly all viewers described the triangles and the circle as characters with motives [14].
heider-simmel.credit: Film: Heider and Simmel, 1944, via Internet Archive
heider-simmel.alt: Grainy film frame: a large triangle, a small triangle and a small circle beside a box with a hinged door, drawn in dark lines on white.

xerox-star.caption: The Xerox Star 8010 desktop (1981): documents, folders, printers, and in- and out-baskets [35].
xerox-star.alt: Black-and-white screen of the Xerox Star desktop: icons for folders, documents, an appointment book, printers, and in- and out-baskets on a dotted background.

shrdlu.caption: SHRDLU’s blocks world at the command “Pick up a big red block,” from Winograd’s 1971 MIT report.
shrdlu.credit: Terry Winograd, Procedures as a Representation for Data in a Computer Program for Understanding Natural Language, MIT AI Technical Report 235, 1971, fig. 4, via DTIC / Internet Archive
shrdlu.alt: Line drawing of a table with blocks, pyramids and an open box, labelled red, green and blue, with a robot hand hanging above. Handwritten above: “Pick up a big red block.”

image2.caption: The ark of studies, as engraved in Vincent Placcius’s De arte excerpendi (1689) [29].
image2.alt: Engraving of Placcius’s ark of studies: an open cabinet with rows of hooks and labelled slips of paper behind its doors, and drawers below.

placcius-slips.caption: Detail of the ark: excerpt slips hang from hooks under lettered headings [29].
placcius-slips.alt: Close-up of the engraving: vertical rails with rows of hooks under the letters G, H, I, L and M, with paper slips hanging from some of them.

kc135-checklist.near: Cockpit checklists work the same way
kc135-checklist.caption: Co-pilot Captain Trent Parker reads the pre-flight checklist before a KC-135 air-refuelling mission, 2014.
kc135-checklist.credit: U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Vernon Young Jr., public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
kc135-checklist.alt: A pilot in a dim cockpit, lit by red light, reads a checklist on his lap among glowing instruments.
